description: Read one recycle plan by its id, or list the plans of one program (or all four), oldest first. For a plan: its state (evidence recorded, authorized, acted, closed or withdrawn), the evidence amount, the counterparty quotes, the PUBLISHED plan (its hash, its exact terms and the exact authorization sentence the operator would sign, public before he authorizes anything and showing no wallet), the exact-amount authorization and what the operator reports he did. It says plainly that nothing was bought by this code: a plan is paperwork for a purchase the operator makes himself, it is house activity and never outside demand, and each plan stands on its own evidence and its own cap, never added into a pooled figure. The source words, reference and figures behind a surplus are never shown here. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.
